title: Names of God
definition: The names of God in Scripture reveal His character, authority, covenant faithfulness, saving power, and relationship to His people.
summary: In Scripture, God's names are not empty labels. They reveal who He is and how He acts toward His creation and His covenant people. Names such as LORD, God Almighty, Shepherd, Redeemer, Father, and King help believers understand God's greatness, nearness, care, power, and saving purpose. The names of God lead the heart into worship and trust.
christFocus: The names and titles of God find their fullest revelation in Christ. Jesus is Immanuel, God with us; the Good Shepherd; the Word made flesh; Lord; Savior; and the One who bears the divine name with authority.

studySections.heading: The LORD Reveals Covenant Faithfulness
studySections.content: The name LORD emphasizes God's covenant faithfulness, self-existence, and saving commitment to His people.

studySections.heading: God's Names Teach Trust
studySections.content: When Scripture reveals God as Shepherd, Rock, Refuge, King, Father, and Redeemer, believers are invited to trust Him according to His revealed character.

studySections.heading: God's Name Is Holy
studySections.content: The name of God is to be honored, not treated lightly. Reverence for God's name reflects reverence for God Himself.
